Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — demo scheduling

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Acme AI's inference needs. Quick recap from our side: 
- Primary goals: speed up latency for real-time agents, reduce per-token cost for high-throughput batch scoring.
- Top constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data, need for predictable SLAs and private deployment options.
- Key stakeholders: you (product), Samantha (ML infra), and procurement later in the cycle.

Next recommended step: 60-min technical deep dive + live demo where we can:
1) map your current request/latency profile to our serving configs,
2) run through quantization/throughput tradeoffs, and
3) show routing/fallback policies for reliability.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 8/27 10:00–11:00am PT
- Thu 8/28 1:00–2:00pm PT
- Fri 8/29 8:30–9:30am PT

If none of those work, tell me 2–3 windows that do and we’ll lock it. I’m including Marissa (AE) and Jordan (solutions engineer) so we can cover commercial and deep technical questions.

I’ve attached a short product one-pager and a mutual action plan template for your review. If one of the slots above works, reply with the slot and I’ll send a calendar invite and a pre-demo checklist (brief ask: representative dataset samples, production traffic profile).

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Evelyn Hart | redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-product-one-pager.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Sorry again for the scramble — appreciate the flexibility.

—Alex
